description: This PHP class defines the CandidateAttachment entity for ORM, representing attachments associated with candidates in the recruitment module of OrangeHRM. It includes properties for file metadata and content, and methods for accessing and modifying these properties.

classes.name: CandidateAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing candidate attachments in the system with properties for the attachment's info and content.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this attachment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this attachment.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Associates a Candidate object with this attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the file name of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the file name of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the attachment (e.g., MIME type).

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: setFileSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the file, either as a resource or string.

methods.name: setFileContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the file.
